customManagers.description: Dockerfile ARGs carrying a '# renovate:' annotation. Docker ones are switched off below: the built-in dockerfile manager already follows ARG defaults used in FROM (tag + digest), so matching them here too would open a second PR per image.
Chart values carrying a '# renovate:' annotation on the line above the key.

packageRules.description: Docker images in the Dockerfile belong to the built-in dockerfile manager; the regex manager above would duplicate them.
Base images: the image workflow's Trivy gate runs on the PR, so digest and patch/minor bumps of the same tag line merge on green. Majors (node 24 -> 26) stay manual.
GitHub Actions: pinned by digest; non-major updates merge on green.

cyrus-ai: the version must move with cyrus.integrity, which Renovate cannot compute. Never automerged; a release must age before it is proposed, since the closure runs agent code with repo write access.
prBodyNotes: ⚠ Before merging, set `cyrus.integrity` in `chart/cyrus/values.yaml` in this PR: `npm view cyrus-ai@{{{newVersion}}} dist.integrity`. Without it the entrypoint stops at start (FATAL: registry metadata ... advertises integrity). If you use `cyrus.lockfileConfigMap`, regenerate the lockfile too.

packageRules.description: mise: the Dockerfile verifies the tarball against MISE_SHA256_amd64, which Renovate cannot compute. The build fails closed until it is updated.
prBodyNotes: ⚠ Before merging, update `MISE_SHA256_amd64` in the Dockerfile in this PR: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/jdx/mise/releases/download/{{{newVersion}}}/mise-{{{newVersion}}}-linux-x64.tar.gz | sha256sum`. Without it the image build fails at `sha256sum -c`.

packageRules.description: litellm subchart is vendored under chart/cyrus/charts so Argo CD needs no OCI credentials; update the archive with the lock. Off by default in the chart, so never automerged.
